pages.text: $(italic)Survival investment. Benefits every class but is essential for Vanguard and Paladin.$(/italic)$(br2)HP, armor toughness, knockback resistance, and healing received are attribute-based and apply immediately. All-resistance (flat % DR) and HP regen require KubeJS bridge script (implemented in Phase 1).

pages.title: Nodes
pages.text: $(bold)Max HP$(/bold) — Increases base max HP. Does NOT interact with the half-equipment-HP rule for glass cannon classes.$(br2)$(bold)Armor Toughness$(/bold) — Standard armor toughness attribute. Especially valuable vs high-damage single hits.$(br2)$(bold)Healing Received$(/bold) — apothic_attributes:healing_received — percentage bonus to all incoming heals.

pages.title: Nodes (cont.)
pages.text: $(bold)Resilience Branch$(/bold) — All-resistance (flat DR %). KubeJS-implemented. Stacks diminishingly with armor.$(br2)$(bold)Regeneration Branch$(/bold) — Passive HP regen via tick-based KubeJS healing. Applies every 5 seconds.$(br2)$(bold)Fortitude Capstone$(/bold) — $(bold)Unbreakable Spirit$(/bold) — Once per combat encounter: survive a killing blow at 1 HP. 10 min cooldown.
